summary: Iteration 3 (view-mode toggle + per-page background color with 1cm white margin) fully verified. Backend smoke regression 13/13 pass (books CRUD + assets endpoints). Frontend Playwright verifies: view-mode-toggle with single/spread buttons, spread pairing convention (page 0 alone with spread-placeholder on left, 1-2 paired, 3-4 paired), three right tabs (assets/page/block) with block disabled when nothing selected, PagePanel renders swatches grid + custom color trigger/input + page-number switch, swatch click sets background_color and persists via PUT /api/books, page-color-fill-0 is absolutely positioned and inset by 37.8px (1cm) on all sides with the outer page-canvas background staying #FFFFFF, page-number switch toggles show_page_number and persists, selecting a block auto-switches to Block tab, deselecting returns to Page tab.

design_issues.screen: Editor desk - page focus ring in spread
issues: Spread focus ring (terracotta) only shown on active page is good, but the SpreadPlaceholder (data-testid='spread-placeholder') uses a fixed 200px width independent of pageSize - looks small when page is A4 portrait; consider scaling to match the actual page width

Dark swatches (#1C1B19 ink, #1F2D3D midnight) blend into the dark right-sidebar surrounding when not active - the border color (border-rule) provides minimal contrast on dark bg. The Page tab content has its own bg-paper so this is actually fine in practice.

critical_code_review_comments: Editor.jsx has grown to ~860 lines (above the 700 LOC guideline) - PageCanvas, SpreadPlaceholder and PageThumbnail are all inlined; recommend extracting these to /app/frontend/src/components/PageCanvas.jsx, PageThumbnail.jsx, SpreadPlaceholder.jsx. The agent-context-note explicitly asks not to refactor this iteration, but it should be done next.

renderSpread() inside Editor.jsx hard-codes the pairing rules. For very large books this still O(1) so fine, but the logic 'activePageIndex % 2 === 1 -> left' is non-obvious; consider extracting to a getSpreadIndices(activePageIndex, total) helper with unit-test coverage.

PageCanvas re-computes scale via window resize listener but never re-runs when viewMode changes from spread->single in same mount. Looking at the deps: pageSize.width, pageSize.height, forExport, viewMode - viewMode IS in deps, so OK. However the spread view renders two PageCanvas instances each with their own scale state; if they get a slightly different scale due to timing the layout will be uneven. Consider lifting scale state up.

PagePanel hex testid 'page-color-#XXXXXX' uses the literal '#' in data-testid which works but CSS attribute selectors with '#' require escaping; tests work because Playwright uses string match. Acceptable, but document this contract.
Custom color popover triggers onChange on every input event (no debounce) - if user drags the color picker for a few seconds this could fire dozens of state updates. Consider debouncing onChange.

The page-color-fill div uses pointerEvents:'none' - good, prevents intercepting block drags. But page-number text is rendered AFTER the fill in DOM order, meaning if user picks a dark background the page number stays #4A4843 (dark grey on dark bg). Consider auto-contrasting the page number text color (e.g. light on dark backgrounds).
PageThumbnail uses inline color fill scaled by PAGE_MARGIN_PX*scale to mirror the editor - correct, ensures thumbnails reflect the colored area faithfully.
The 'A 1cm white margin frames the colored area for safe printing.' helper text in PagePanel is excellent UX copy - keep it.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Iter3_Book and TEST_Iter3_Deselect books during run; both deleted via DELETE /api/books at end of run. No residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter-3 features verified. Key gotcha for next agent: clicking on a PageCanvas does NOT deselect (the canvas calls e.stopPropagation() on mousedown for focus). To test deselect, click on the empty desk area outside the page (e.g. x=300 when viewport=1920 wide). For swatch selectors, data-testid uses literal hex including '#': use Playwright string selector [data-testid="page-color-#9E4532"]. PAGE_MARGIN_PX=37.8; the page-color-fill-{i} div is offset by exactly that and pageWidth-2*37.8. REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL must be exported in the shell before running pytest since test_assets_api.py uses os.environ[...] without default.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. The transient deselect-test failure during first run was due to clicking on the active text-block area rather than empty desk - re-test confirmed correct behavior.
